bio: Against the backdrop of vineyards and the rolling hills that surround Leibnitz, the setting is almost heavenly. The marvellous tiered terrace and a lounge area beneath the arcade are, of course, extremely inviting in summer. The interior is equally delightful, with its stylish modern design and floor-to-ceiling windows affording stunning views. Here, you can look forward to contemporary seasonal cuisine paired with an excellent wine list and exceptionally friendly, attentive service....
